settings.boundary: Pinned historical mirror reproduction and separately named causal/time-axis repair controls. Keep full source hyperparameters, stride-one training, source early stopping on test, source pooled train/test score calibration, original PA and original dropped inference tails. Neither branch proves journal equivalence or strict TAB generalization. Config axes on source_runtime are mirror sensitivity controls; e_layers produces e_layers-1 active layers. Temperature/stream grid is posthoc diagnostic, never select a strict leaderboard result using test labels.
